notes: The 10-year US interest rate (5.10%) is 1.03% above the 3-month rate (4.07%), a normal gap that has changed little in 3 months.
Copper and gold have moved about the same over 3 months (+0.2% for copper vs gold): no strong growth signal.
Oil is up 18% in 6 months. That pushes prices up across the economy (inflation), which is typical late in a boom.
The US stock market (S&P 500) is above its average price over the last 200 trading days (about 10 months): its long-term uptrend is intact.

todaysConditions.note: Oil is up 19% over 3 months: a boost for oil-heavy markets, a cost for big oil importers.
Chip-maker shares did 5.5% worse than world stocks over 3 months: a drag on tech-heavy markets.
